description: This file defines the 'Question' entity class for a Java project using JPA annotations. It models a question with fields such as title, content, creation date, and a list of answers, including typical entity behavior and relationships.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Entity class representing a question with title, content, timestamp, and associated answers.

methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize title and content.
